objects.description: During the [C0032](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0032) campaign, [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) used port-protocol mismatches on ports such as 443, 4444, 8531, and 50501 during C2.(Citation: FireEye TRITON 2019)
objects.description_fa: در طول کمپین [C0032](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0032)، [TEMP.Veles](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0088) از عدم تطابق پورت-پروتکل در پورت هایی مانند 443، 4444، 85051 و 5 استفاده کرد. C2.(Citation: FireEye TRITON 2019)
